anti_patterns: Do not let the grant seal become a decorative bullet — it must appear only beside an actual claim about a specific grant/approval/checkpoint, never as generic visual punctuation, or it loses its argument that authority is bounded and deliberate.
Do not spread --grant/--revoked as general accents — reserved exclusively for showing an active vs. revoked/expired authorization state.
Do not diverge the shared structural tokens from Neotoma's — see Neotoma identity's matching anti-pattern.

Do not reuse the Neotoma app/Inspector's warm cream/terracotta palette — this identity's deepened wax-seal red-brown (#8a3b1f) is deliberately distinct from both the inspector's terracotta and from the current live page's lighter amber (#9a5b14), per ruled decision public_pages_do_not_reuse_inspector_palette (plan ent_98ef9d45f8a6896fed408f8f).

border_radius.note: KEPT VERBATIM: 10px cards/panels, 8px buttons, 999px toggle pill.

positioning_principles: Authority properties get visual devices, not prose: declared/scoped/approved/attributed-to-a-principal map to specific moves (grant seal = declared+scoped; quorum diagram = approved; bracketed scope micro-format = attributed) rather than being asserted in copy alone.

Grant seal (signature move): a single small bounded inline-SVG mark (circular, quoted attributes) placed next to any claim about a specific grant, approval, or checkpoint — never diffused as a background wash. Visual argument for 'declared and scoped' as opposed to 'implicit and diffuse'; deliberately the opposite device from Neotoma's continuous provenance rail (authority is granted discretely, not accumulated).

Quorum diagram (signature move): one instance renders an actual small SVG diagram — 3 circles, 2 filled --grant green + 1 outlined — captioned with the real mechanism name ('quorum: 2 of 3 distinct principals'), showing an approval threshold rather than describing it in prose.
Iconography: seal glyph, a 'scope boundary' bracket motif, and a two-vertical-bar checkpoint/gate glyph replace the single generic Feather-style line icon currently shared visually with Neotoma.
Color as seal, not wash: accent is a bounded, deliberately deepened terracotta-red used sparingly per authorized act, never as a diffuse hero gradient or background fill.
identity.scope: Ateles product pages only (distinct from the shared structural design_system ent_72e01f1008653b601be1a956, which this entity does NOT replace or overwrite). A DESIGNED, not-yet-applied identity: derives its signature devices from Ateles's category as 'the distributed-authority operating layer for governed initiative' — declared, scoped, approved, attributed-to-a-principal — rather than from a generic dev-tool palette. Siblings with, not twins of, the Neotoma identity (ent to be linked): shares the existing structural system but diverges in accent palette, the JOB assigned to the monospace type family, and one signature move (a bounded 'grant seal' mark used sparingly per authorized act) that is the deliberate visual OPPOSITE of Neotoma's continuous provenance rail — authority is granted discretely, not accumulated continuously.

spacing_system.note: KEPT VERBATIM from the shared design_system ent_72e01f1008653b601be1a956 — same rationale as the Neotoma identity: shared skeleton, divergent skin.

color_palette.rationale: Seal/stamp metaphor, not a diffuse SaaS accent wash: an authority system's oldest visual analogue is a mark that says 'this was authorized' — bounded and applied deliberately, never ambient. Terracotta retained as seed hue from the current live palette (evolutionary) but deepened/more saturated (#8a3b1f vs current #9a5b14) to read as a wax-seal red-brown rather than 'friendly SaaS orange'. 'grant' and 'revoked' are NEW semantic color roles mapped to the product's own real vocabulary (blast_radius_for(), low/high_blast_action_types) — reserved exclusively for an active vs. revoked/expired grant state.

wcag_aa_verified_2026_09_21.method: relative-luminance WCAG contrast formula computed directly (python), all 8 pairs exceed 4.5:1 AA-normal-text threshold with margin; the deepened accent gains contrast headroom as a side effect of the seal rationale, not as a separate fix

type_scale.code_font_family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
type_scale.google_fonts_licence: All three (Space Grotesk, Source Sans 3, IBM Plex Mono) are free, open-license Google Fonts already loaded via @import on the live page — no cost, no licensing action needed.
type_scale.rationale: Family kept deliberately: research fetched 2026-09-21 (typewolf.com/space-grotesk, madegooddesigns.com/space-grotesk-font) found Space Grotesk's real-world brand associations (NordVPN, Lemonade, Miro) are generic 'forward-looking tech', not authority-specific — a NEGATIVE finding that ruled out chasing a 'more authoritative' type family (none of the researched alternatives specifically signal governance either) and instead justified changing the type's JOB. IBM Plex Mono is elevated from generic code font to carrying a compact bracketed scope micro-format next to every grant/role/checkpoint mention — e.g. '[blast:low · expires:30d]', '[quorum:2/3]' — using real vocabulary from the product's own code, not invented labels.
